prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single 16:9 cinematic concept frame for a three-minute AI business brand film screened to an adult industry-event audience.
Input images: image 1 is official Chacha identity; image 2 is official Chamei identity; image 3 is an existing 3D Chacha material/volume reference ONLY, not an instruction to add suited twins. Exactly two characters: ONE green-shirt Chacha and ONE orange-hood Chamei.
Preserve identities in a fully volumetric 3D translation: Chacha has a broad rounded WHITE face, subtle tiny ears, compact body, small round black eyes and black nose, little expressive mouth, mint-green T-shirt, large white tail with exactly two black markings. Do not turn it into a realistically proportioned cat, otter, rodent, or bear. No whiskers, no long muzzle, no giant anime eyes. Chamei retains orange bear-ear hood with small bear nose/eyes on top, brown fringe and side hair, warm pale stylized face, small dark oval eyes, rosy cheeks and rounded hands. Her anatomy and facial proportions remain stylized, never a real child or a photorealistic human face. Waist-up framing; no new lower-body design.
Shared scene for comparison: Chacha on left and Chamei on right beside each other at an AI demo worktable in an architectural studio. Chacha holds up a small dark-framed tablet at chest height, its screen showing three SIMPLE flat mint icons: image, audio waveform, text. Chamei studies it with a slight curious head tilt and one hand lightly touching the tabletop; restrained intelligent expressions, closed or slightly parted mouths, no exaggerated delighted baby smiles. A closed laptop and one small watermelon slice sit on the table. Background contains workstation geometry and glass partitions, no other characters. Characters should appear physically present and interact with the props.
No text, no logos, no watermark, no reference-sheet layout, no grid, no floating holograms. Green is a controlled brand accent, alongside natural warm neutrals, charcoal and Chamei's orange; NOT an all-mint pastel nursery. The result should be markedly more physically convincing than a smooth pastel toy render.
Style/medium: high-end cinematic CG animated feature look, stylized character geometry with physically realistic material response. Chacha's white surface has extraordinarily short, densely groomed microfur, almost velvety rather than shaggy. His green shirt has visible subtle cotton-knit structure, seam finishing and natural folds. Chamei's hood is orange woven cloth with realistic stitched edges and soft folds; hair has controlled fine-strand detail in stylized clumps; face has gentle subsurface light transport without realistic human pores. Table is muted walnut and brushed metal, realistic glass behind. Sophisticated appealing character design, mature art direction, no plastic figurine aesthetic.
Lighting/camera: strong but soft motivated window key from upper left, controlled shadow falloff, quiet neutral fill, delicate rim light separating silhouettes, natural reflections and subtle depth of field. 40mm cinema lens, eye-level medium two-shot with both faces sharp, gentle three-quarter perspective, carefully composed negative space. Daylight-balanced highlights and warm wood bounce, rich restrained color, natural midtones; not dark and gritty, not orange-teal blockbuster grading. Entire environment is a coherent cinematic CG world at the characters' scale.
